msg.move-note.face.r.clockwise: Turn the Right face clockwise: the right column moves up.
msg.move-note.face.r.counterclockwise: Turn the Right face counter-clockwise: the right column moves down.
msg.move-note.face.r.half: Turn the Right face a half turn: the right column moves halfway around.
msg.move-note.face.f.clockwise: Turn the Front face clockwise: the front layer turns to the right.
msg.move-note.face.f.counterclockwise: Turn the Front face counter-clockwise: the front layer turns to the left.
msg.move-note.face.f.half: Turn the Front face a half turn: the front layer moves halfway around.
msg.move-note.face.d.clockwise: Turn the Down face clockwise: the bottom row moves right.
msg.move-note.face.d.counterclockwise: Turn the Down face counter-clockwise: the bottom row moves left.
msg.move-note.face.d.half: Turn the Down face a half turn: the bottom row moves halfway around.
msg.move-note.face.l.clockwise: Turn the Left face clockwise: the left column moves down.
msg.move-note.face.l.counterclockwise: Turn the Left face counter-clockwise: the left column moves up.
msg.move-note.face.l.half: Turn the Left face a half turn: the left column moves halfway around.
msg.move-note.face.b.clockwise: Turn the Back face clockwise: the back layer turns to the left, as seen from the front.
msg.move-note.face.b.counterclockwise: Turn the Back face counter-clockwise: the back layer turns to the right, as seen from the front.
msg.move-note.face.b.half: Turn the Back face a half turn: the back layer moves halfway around.
msg.move-note.wide.u.clockwise: Turn the Up two layers clockwise: the top two rows move left.
msg.move-note.wide.u.counterclockwise: Turn the Up two layers counter-clockwise: the top two rows move right.
msg.move-note.wide.u.half: Turn the Up two layers a half turn: the top two rows move halfway around.
msg.move-note.wide.r.clockwise: Turn the Right two layers clockwise: the right two columns move up.
msg.move-note.wide.r.counterclockwise: Turn the Right two layers counter-clockwise: the right two columns move down.
msg.move-note.wide.r.half: Turn the Right two layers a half turn: the right two columns move halfway around.
msg.move-note.wide.f.clockwise: Turn the Front two layers clockwise: the front two layers turn to the right.
msg.move-note.wide.f.counterclockwise: Turn the Front two layers counter-clockwise: the front two layers turn to the left.
msg.move-note.wide.f.half: Turn the Front two layers a half turn: the front two layers move halfway around.
msg.move-note.wide.d.clockwise: Turn the Down two layers clockwise: the bottom two rows move right.
msg.move-note.wide.d.counterclockwise: Turn the Down two layers counter-clockwise: the bottom two rows move left.
msg.move-note.wide.d.half: Turn the Down two layers a half turn: the bottom two rows move halfway around.
msg.move-note.wide.l.clockwise: Turn the Left two layers clockwise: the left two columns move down.
msg.move-note.wide.l.counterclockwise: Turn the Left two layers counter-clockwise: the left two columns move up.
msg.move-note.wide.l.half: Turn the Left two layers a half turn: the left two columns move halfway around.
msg.move-note.wide.b.clockwise: Turn the Back two layers clockwise: the back two layers turn to the left, as seen from the front.
msg.move-note.wide.b.counterclockwise: Turn the Back two layers counter-clockwise: the back two layers turn to the right, as seen from the front.
msg.move-note.wide.b.half: Turn the Back two layers a half turn: the back two layers move halfway around.
msg.move-note.slice.m.clockwise: Turn the middle layer between Left and Right clockwise, like the Left face: the middle column moves down.
msg.move-note.slice.m.counterclockwise: Turn the middle layer between Left and Right counter-clockwise, like the Left face: the middle column moves up.
msg.move-note.slice.m.half: Turn the middle layer between Left and Right a half turn: the middle column moves halfway around.
msg.move-note.slice.e.clockwise: Turn the middle layer between Up and Down clockwise, like the Down face: the middle row moves right.
msg.move-note.slice.e.counterclockwise: Turn the middle layer between Up and Down counter-clockwise, like the Down face: the middle row moves left.
msg.move-note.slice.e.half: Turn the middle layer between Up and Down a half turn: the middle row moves halfway around.

msg.move-note.slice.s.half: Turn the middle layer between Front and Back a half turn: the middle layer moves halfway around.

stage.stage-01-fundamentals.title: Cube fundamentals
lesson.lesson-01-01.objective: Tell centers, edges and corners apart, then turn the top face.
lesson.lesson-01-01.learner-action: Turn the top face a quarter turn clockwise: U.
lesson.lesson-01-01.goal.1: You turn the top face a quarter turn clockwise, U.
lesson.lesson-01-01.keep.1: A face turn never moves a center. The bottom two layers stay as they are.
lesson.lesson-01-01.watch.1: Look at the white center on top. Find an edge, with two colors, and a corner, with three.
lesson.lesson-01-01.notice.1: The four top edges and four top corners moved together. Every center stayed in place.
lesson.lesson-01-02.objective: Read a face letter and turn that face: R, then U.
lesson.lesson-01-02.learner-action: Turn the right face, R, then the top face, U.
lesson.lesson-01-02.goal.1: You turn the right face a quarter turn clockwise, R.
lesson.lesson-01-02.keep.1: The left two layers stay where they are.
lesson.lesson-01-02.watch.1: Look at the red center on the right face. Clockwise means as you see it when you face it.
lesson.lesson-01-02.notice.1: The right layer turned. Green stickers now sit in the right column of the top face.
lesson.lesson-01-02.goal.2: You turn the top face a quarter turn clockwise, U.
lesson.lesson-01-02.keep.2: The bottom two layers stay as they are.
lesson.lesson-01-02.watch.2: Look at the white center on top. The letter U names the top face.
lesson.lesson-01-02.notice.2: The top layer turned. The bottom layer stayed as R left it.
lesson.lesson-01-03.objective: Read prime and double Moves: R' turns back, and U2 turns twice.
lesson.lesson-01-03.learner-action: Turn the right face counterclockwise, R', then the top face twice, U2.
lesson.lesson-01-03.goal.1: You turn the right face a quarter turn counterclockwise, R'.
lesson.lesson-01-03.keep.1: The left two layers stay where they are.
lesson.lesson-01-03.watch.1: Look at the right face. The prime mark ' means you turn it against the clock.
lesson.lesson-01-03.notice.1: The right layer turned the other way. Blue stickers now sit in the right column of the top face.
lesson.lesson-01-03.goal.2: You turn the top face a half turn, U2.
lesson.lesson-01-03.keep.2: The bottom two layers stay as they are.
lesson.lesson-01-03.watch.2: Look at the top face. The 2 means two quarter turns, in either direction.
lesson.lesson-01-03.notice.2: Each top piece moved to the opposite side. The bottom two layers did not move.
stage.stage-02-first-cross.title: First cross
lesson.lesson-02-01.objective: Bring the white-green edge up from the bottom into the white cross.
lesson.lesson-02-01.learner-action: Turn the front face twice: F2.
lesson.lesson-02-01.goal.1: You lift the white-green edge to the top with F2.
lesson.lesson-02-01.keep.1: Keep the other three white cross edges on top. F2 does not touch them.
lesson.lesson-02-01.watch.1: Look at the bottom of the front face. The green sticker sits under the green center, white facing down.
lesson.lesson-02-01.notice.1: The white-green edge is on top, white up. The other cross edges stayed in place.
lesson.lesson-02-02.objective: Line the white-green edge up under its center, then bring it up.
lesson.lesson-02-02.learner-action: Turn the bottom face, D', then the front face twice, F2.
lesson.lesson-02-02.goal.1: You move the white-green edge under the green center with D'.
lesson.lesson-02-02.keep.1: Keep the three white cross edges on top. D' turns only the bottom layer.
lesson.lesson-02-02.watch.1: Look at the bottom layer. The white-green edge sits under the red center, white facing down.
lesson.lesson-02-02.notice.1: The edge now sits under the green center. The top layer did not move.
lesson.lesson-02-02.goal.2: You lift the white-green edge to the top with F2.
lesson.lesson-02-02.keep.2: Keep the other three white cross edges on top. F2 does not touch them.
lesson.lesson-02-02.watch.2: Look at the front face. Green sits under green, with white facing down.
lesson.lesson-02-02.notice.2: The white cross is whole. Each edge matches the center beside it.
lesson.lesson-02-03.objective: Bring the white-green edge up from the middle layer.
lesson.lesson-02-03.learner-action: Turn the front face counterclockwise: F'.
lesson.lesson-02-03.goal.1: You lift the white-green edge into the cross with F'.
lesson.lesson-02-03.keep.1: Keep the other three white cross edges on top. F' does not touch them.
lesson.lesson-02-03.watch.1: Look between the front and right centers. Green faces you, and white faces right.
lesson.lesson-02-03.notice.1: The edge rose to the top with white up. The other cross edges stayed in place.
lesson.lesson-02-04.objective: Fix the white-green edge when it sits on top but flipped.
lesson.lesson-02-04.learner-action: Move the edge down with U' R' U, then bring it up with F'.
lesson.lesson-02-04.goal.1: You move the flipped edge down to the middle layer with U' R' U.
lesson.lesson-02-04.keep.1: Keep the other three cross edges. U' moves them aside, and U puts them back.
lesson.lesson-02-04.watch.1: Look at the top front edge. Green faces up, and white faces you.
lesson.lesson-02-04.notice.1: The edge now sits between the front and right centers, white facing right. The other cross edges are back.
lesson.lesson-02-04.goal.2: You lift the white-green edge into the cross with F'.
lesson.lesson-02-04.keep.2: Keep the other three white cross edges on top. F' does not touch them.
lesson.lesson-02-04.watch.2: Look between the front and right centers. Green faces you, and white faces right.
lesson.lesson-02-04.notice.2: The white cross is whole, and the white-green edge is no longer flipped.
lesson.lesson-02-05.objective: Build the whole white cross, one edge at a time.
lesson.lesson-02-05.learner-action: Bring each edge up with a half turn: F2, R2, B2, then L2.
lesson.lesson-02-05.goal.1: You lift the white-green edge to the top with F2.
lesson.lesson-02-05.keep.1: Keep the white center on top, so each edge has its place.
lesson.lesson-02-05.watch.1: Look at the bottom layer. Each cross edge sits under its own center, white facing down.
lesson.lesson-02-05.notice.1: The white-green edge is on top. The other three still wait below.
lesson.lesson-02-05.goal.2: You lift the white-red edge to the top with R2.
lesson.lesson-02-05.keep.2: Keep the white-green edge on top. R2 does not touch it.
lesson.lesson-02-05.watch.2: Look under the red center. The white-red edge waits there, white facing down.
lesson.lesson-02-05.notice.2: Two cross edges are on top. The white-green edge stayed in place.
lesson.lesson-02-05.goal.3: You lift the white-blue edge to the top with B2.
lesson.lesson-02-05.keep.3: Keep the white-green and white-red edges on top. B2 does not touch them.
lesson.lesson-02-05.watch.3: Look under the blue center at the back. The white-blue edge waits there.
lesson.lesson-02-05.notice.3: Three cross edges are on top. The first two stayed in place.
lesson.lesson-02-05.goal.4: You lift the white-orange edge to the top with L2.
lesson.lesson-02-05.keep.4: Keep the three cross edges on top. L2 does not touch them.
lesson.lesson-02-05.watch.4: Look under the orange center on the left. The last cross edge waits there.
lesson.lesson-02-05.notice.4: The white cross is whole. Each edge matches the center beside it.
stage.stage-03-first-layer-corners.title: First-layer corners
lesson.lesson-03-01.objective: Insert the white-green-red corner when its white sticker faces right.
lesson.lesson-03-01.learner-action: Turn R' D' R to lift the corner into place.
lesson.lesson-03-01.goal.1: You lift the white-green-red corner into the top layer with R' D' R.
lesson.lesson-03-01.keep.1: Keep the white cross. R' moves part of it down, and R brings it back.
lesson.lesson-03-01.watch.1: Look at the corner at the bottom front right. Its white sticker faces right.
lesson.lesson-03-01.notice.1: The corner is in the top layer with white up. The cross is whole again.
lesson.lesson-03-02.objective: Insert the white-green-red corner when its white sticker faces you.
lesson.lesson-03-02.learner-action: Turn F D F' to lift the corner into place.
lesson.lesson-03-02.goal.1: You lift the white-green-red corner into the top layer with F D F'.
lesson.lesson-03-02.keep.1: Keep the white cross. F moves part of it aside, and F' brings it back.
lesson.lesson-03-02.watch.1: Look at the corner at the bottom front right. Its white sticker faces you.
lesson.lesson-03-02.notice.1: The corner is in the top layer with white up. The cross is whole again.
lesson.lesson-03-03.objective: Insert the white-green-red corner when its white sticker faces down.
lesson.lesson-03-03.learner-action: Turn the corner with R' D2 R D, then insert it with R' D' R.
lesson.lesson-03-03.goal.1: You turn the corner so its white sticker faces right, with R' D2 R D.
lesson.lesson-03-03.keep.1: Keep the white cross. R' moves part of it down, and R brings it back.
lesson.lesson-03-03.watch.1: Look at the corner at the bottom front right. Its white sticker faces down.
lesson.lesson-03-03.notice.1: The corner is back at the bottom front right, white facing right. The cross is whole.
lesson.lesson-03-03.goal.2: You lift the corner into the top layer with R' D' R.
lesson.lesson-03-03.keep.2: Keep the white cross. R' moves part of it down, and R brings it back.
lesson.lesson-03-03.watch.2: Look at the corner at the bottom front right. Its white sticker now faces right.
lesson.lesson-03-03.notice.2: The corner is in the top layer with white up. The cross is whole again.
lesson.lesson-03-04.objective: Insert all four white corners and keep the cross.
lesson.lesson-03-04.learner-action: Insert each corner with three turns: R' D' R, B' D' B, L' D' L, then F' D' F.
lesson.lesson-03-04.goal.1: You insert the white-green-red corner with R' D' R.
lesson.lesson-03-04.keep.1: Keep the white cross. R' moves part of it down, and R brings it back.
lesson.lesson-03-04.watch.1: Look at the corner at the bottom front right. Its white sticker faces right.
lesson.lesson-03-04.notice.1: The white-green-red corner is in the top layer. The cross is whole again.
lesson.lesson-03-04.goal.2: You insert the white-red-blue corner with B' D' B.
lesson.lesson-03-04.keep.2: Keep the cross and the first corner. B' moves part of the cross down, and B brings it back.
lesson.lesson-03-04.watch.2: Look at the corner at the bottom right back. Its white sticker faces the back.
lesson.lesson-03-04.notice.2: Two corners are in place. The cross and the first corner stayed.
lesson.lesson-03-04.goal.3: You insert the white-blue-orange corner with L' D' L.
lesson.lesson-03-04.keep.3: Keep the cross and the two placed corners. L' D' L does not touch those corners.
lesson.lesson-03-04.watch.3: Look at the corner at the bottom back left. Its white sticker faces left.
lesson.lesson-03-04.notice.3: Three corners are in place. The cross and the other corners stayed.
lesson.lesson-03-04.goal.4: You insert the white-orange-green corner with F' D' F.
lesson.lesson-03-04.keep.4: Keep the cross and the three placed corners. F' moves some of them aside, and F brings them back.
lesson.lesson-03-04.watch.4: Look at the corner at the bottom front left. Its white sticker faces you.
lesson.lesson-03-04.notice.4: All four corners are in place. The first layer is solved.
lesson.lesson-04-01.objective: Insert the front-right middle edge from the bottom layer.
lesson.lesson-04-01.learner-action: Move the bottom edge to the right with D' R' D R D F D' F'.
lesson.lesson-04-01.goal.1: You insert the green-red edge to the right with D' R' D R D F D' F'.
lesson.lesson-04-01.keep.1: Keep the white layer intact. The algorithm moves pieces aside and restores them.
lesson.lesson-04-01.watch.1: Look at the bottom front edge. Its green sticker faces you and red faces down.
lesson.lesson-04-01.notice.1: The green-red edge sits between the green and red centers. The white layer stays intact.
lesson.lesson-04-02.objective: Insert the front-left middle edge from the bottom layer.
lesson.lesson-04-02.learner-action: Move the bottom edge to the left with D L D' L' D' F' D F.
lesson.lesson-04-02.goal.1: You insert the green-orange edge to the left with D L D' L' D' F' D F.
lesson.lesson-04-02.keep.1: Keep the white layer intact. The turns move pieces aside and restore them.
lesson.lesson-04-02.watch.1: Look at the bottom front edge. Its green sticker faces you and orange faces down.
lesson.lesson-04-02.notice.1: The green-orange edge sits between the green and orange centers. The white layer stays intact.
lesson.lesson-04-03.objective: Free a trapped middle edge, then insert it.
lesson.lesson-04-03.learner-action: Displace the edge with D' R' D R D F D' F'. Insert it with D L D' L' D' F' D F.
lesson.lesson-04-03.goal.1: You move the stuck edge out to the bottom layer with D' R' D R D F D' F'.
lesson.lesson-04-03.keep.1: Keep the white layer intact. The algorithm restores the top face.
lesson.lesson-04-03.watch.1: Look at the middle right slot. The edge is trapped in the middle layer.
lesson.lesson-04-03.notice.1: The trapped edge is now in the bottom layer, ready to be placed.
lesson.lesson-04-03.goal.2: You insert the free edge into its slot with D L D' L' D' F' D F.
lesson.lesson-04-03.keep.2: Keep the white layer and other middle edges intact.
lesson.lesson-04-03.watch.2: Look at the bottom front edge. It matches the front center.
lesson.lesson-04-03.notice.2: The middle edge is in its slot. The white layer stays intact.
lesson.lesson-04-04.objective: Solve all four middle-layer edges one by one.
lesson.lesson-04-04.learner-action: Insert each middle edge in turn using the right insertion sequence.
lesson.lesson-04-04.goal.1: You insert the first middle edge with D' R' D R D F D' F'.
lesson.lesson-04-04.keep.1: Keep the white layer intact while placing the edge.
lesson.lesson-04-04.watch.1: Look at the front and right faces. The edge matches its centers.
lesson.lesson-04-04.notice.1: One middle edge is in place. The white layer is intact.
lesson.lesson-04-04.goal.2: You insert the second middle edge with D' B' D B D R D' R'.
lesson.lesson-04-04.keep.2: Keep the first middle edge and the white layer intact.
lesson.lesson-04-04.watch.2: Look at the right and back faces. The edge is lined up.

lesson.lesson-08-01.learner-action: Hold yellow on top with the first two layers solved. Find the dot: only the yellow center faces up, with no yellow edges on top. Only the edges count here, so the corners on your cube may look different.
lesson.lesson-08-01.goal.1: You orient the four last-layer edges so a yellow cross shows on top. This is the first look of 2-look OLL.
lesson.lesson-08-01.keep.1: Keep the first two layers solved. The Algorithm moves them, then puts them back.
lesson.lesson-08-01.watch.1: Watch all four top edges flip until each shows yellow on top.
lesson.lesson-08-01.notice.1: A yellow cross now shows on top. Next, orient the corners, or skip that step if the whole top is already yellow.
lesson.lesson-08-02.learner-action: Hold yellow on top with the first two layers solved. Find the line: two yellow edges face up across from each other. Turn U until the line runs left to right. Only the edges count here, so the corners on your cube may look different.
lesson.lesson-08-02.goal.1: You orient the four last-layer edges so a yellow cross shows on top. This is the first look of 2-look OLL.
lesson.lesson-08-02.keep.1: Keep the first two layers solved. The Algorithm moves them, then puts them back.
lesson.lesson-08-02.watch.1: Watch the two edges at the ends of the line flip up to finish the cross.
lesson.lesson-08-02.notice.1: A yellow cross now shows on top. Next, orient the corners, or skip that step if the whole top is already yellow.
lesson.lesson-08-03.learner-action: Hold yellow on top with the first two layers solved. Find the L: two yellow edges face up next to each other. Turn U until the top matches the picture. Only the edges count here, so the corners on your cube may look different.
lesson.lesson-08-03.goal.1: You orient the four last-layer edges so a yellow cross shows on top. This is the first look of 2-look OLL.
lesson.lesson-08-03.keep.1: Keep the first two layers solved. The Algorithm moves them, then puts them back.
lesson.lesson-08-03.watch.1: Watch the two edges outside the L flip up to finish the cross.
lesson.lesson-08-03.notice.1: A yellow cross now shows on top. Next, orient the corners, or skip that step if the whole top is already yellow.
lesson.lesson-08-04.learner-action: Hold yellow on top with the yellow cross done. Find the H: no corner shows yellow on top, and two opposite sides each show two yellow stickers. Turn U until the top matches the picture.
lesson.lesson-08-04.goal.1: You orient the four last-layer corners so the whole top is yellow. This is the second look of 2-look OLL.

lesson.lesson-08-04.watch.1: Watch both pairs of yellow side stickers turn up onto the top.
lesson.lesson-08-04.notice.1: The whole top is yellow. Next, place the corners, or skip that step if every side already shows matching corner colors.
lesson.lesson-08-05.learner-action: Hold yellow on top with the yellow cross done. Find the Pi: no corner shows yellow on top, and only one side shows two yellow stickers. Turn U until the top matches the picture.

lesson.lesson-08-05.notice.1: The whole top is yellow. Next, place the corners, or skip that step if every side already shows matching corner colors.
lesson.lesson-08-06.learner-action: Hold yellow on top with the yellow cross done. Find the headlights: two corners show yellow on top side by side, and one side shows two yellow stickers. Turn U until the top matches the picture.

lesson.lesson-08-07.goal.1: You orient the four last-layer corners so the whole top is yellow. This is the second look of 2-look OLL.

lesson.lesson-08-07.watch.1: Watch the two outward-facing corners turn up beside the two yellow ones.
lesson.lesson-08-07.notice.1: The whole top is yellow. Next, place the corners, or skip that step if every side already shows matching corner colors.

lesson.lesson-08-09.watch.1: Watch the three twisted corners turn up together.

lesson.lesson-08-10.keep.1: Keep the first two layers and the yellow cross. The Algorithm breaks the cross for a moment, then rebuilds it.
lesson.lesson-08-10.watch.1: Watch the three twisted corners turn up together.

lesson.lesson-09-01.learner-action: Hold yellow on top with the whole top yellow. Find the headlights: one side shows two matching corner colors. Hold that side on the left. Only the corners count here, so the edges on your cube may look different.
lesson.lesson-09-01.goal.1: You place the four last-layer corners so every side shows matching corner colors. This is the first look of 2-look PLL.
lesson.lesson-09-01.keep.1: Keep the first two layers and the yellow top. The Algorithm moves them, then puts them back.
lesson.lesson-09-01.watch.1: Watch the two corners on the right side swap places.
lesson.lesson-09-01.notice.1: Every side shows matching corner colors once you turn U to line them up. Next, place the edges, or skip that step if the layer is solved.
lesson.lesson-09-02.learner-action: Hold yellow on top with the whole top yellow. Find the Y case: no side shows two matching corner colors, so two corners swap across a diagonal. Only the corners count here, so the edges on your cube may look different.

lesson.lesson-09-02.keep.1: Keep the first two layers and the yellow top. The Algorithm moves them, then puts them back.
lesson.lesson-09-02.watch.1: Watch two corners swap across the diagonal of the top.
lesson.lesson-09-02.notice.1: Every side shows matching corner colors once you turn U to line them up. Next, place the edges, or skip that step if the layer is solved.
lesson.lesson-09-03.learner-action: Hold yellow on top with the corners placed. Find the solved side: one side matches all the way across. Hold it at the back. Ua mirrors Ub, so match the front edge to the picture.
lesson.lesson-09-03.goal.1: You place the four last-layer edges to finish the cube. This is the second look of 2-look PLL.
lesson.lesson-09-03.keep.1: Keep the first two layers, the yellow top and the placed corners. The Algorithm moves them, then puts them back.
lesson.lesson-09-03.watch.1: Watch three edges cycle around while the solved side at the back stays put.

lesson.lesson-09-05.watch.1: Watch opposite edges swap across the top.
lesson.lesson-09-05.notice.1: The last layer is solved. If a side does not match its center, finish with a U turn that lines the layer up.
